summary: Iteration_6 frontend test of Phase 1B cross-industry spine on http://localhost:3000 at 390x844, logged in as trades.demo@safebase.com.au / Demo@1234. ALL 12 REVIEW POINTS PASS. (1) Login OK → home. (2) /workers shows 4 demo workers (Jack Mitchell, Anna Liu, Chris Murphy, Dave Pham) with role+trade meta line; workers-back and add-worker-btn render; workers-search 'anna' correctly filters to only Anna Liu. (3) add-worker-btn → /workers/new; filled name 'TEST Worker Z9' + role-worker chip + worker-submit; Alert auto-accepted; redirected back to /workers; new row visible in list. (4) /licences renders 6 demo licence rows with ACTIVE / EXPIRING / EXPIRED pills; all 4 filter chips (lic-filter-all/active/expiring_soon/expired) render and EXPIRED filter reduces to 1 row; lic-remind-* button on first row fires Reminder Alert (window.alert shim accepted). (5) /licences/new — worker chip + type-white_card + lic-number TEST-001 + lic-expiry 2027-12-31 → lic-submit → 'Licence added' Alert → redirect to /licences. (6) /risk shows 'No risks yet' empty state + 5 filter chips (risk-filter-all/low/medium/high/extreme) + add-risk-btn. (7) /risk/new renders every field: risk-title, risk-category, risk-activity, risk-process, risk-hazard, risk-consequence, risk-existing-controls, risk-proposed-controls, risk-owner, risk-due, matrix-inherent, matrix-residual, freq-monthly/quarterly/6-monthly/annually, plus 10 HRCW flag chips. Tapping matrix-inherent-cell-4-4 produced readout 'SCORE 4×4=16 / LEVEL EXTREME / LIKELY × MAJOR'; matrix-residual-cell-2-2 produced 'SCORE 2×2=4 / LEVEL LOW / UNLIKELY × MINOR' — thresholds match the backend _compute_risk_level (≤4 low, ≤9 medium, ≤15 high, else extreme). Filled risk-title 'TEST RISK' → risk-submit → 'Risk added' Alert → /risk; new row visible with INHERENT EXTREME · 16 pill. (8) /notifications returned 4 unread rows with tone icons; notif-mark-all visible (unread > 0). (9) /reports renders all 10 expected reports (report-compliance_score, incidents_trend, licence_expiry, training_matrix, swms_register, toolbox_talks_log, risk_register_export, inspections_summary, plant_register, worker_roster); tapping compliance_score routes to /reports/compliance_score and renders data without crashing. (10) /workflows renders all 5 catalog tabs (wf-type-new_employee, incident_resolution, swms_job_start, annual_review, subcontractor); KPI Card visible with Total/Not started/In progress/Complete labels (rendered uppercase via CSS) and wf-new button. Tapping wf-new on new_employee created a workflow instance — the 'No instances yet' empty state disappeared, confirming a WorkflowStepper rendered for the new instance. (11) Modules tab regression: module-incidents→/incident, module-workers→/workers, module-risks→/risk, module-reports→/reports, module-compliance-inbox→/notifications ALL route to native screens (not /module/[slug]). module-licences / module-workflows / module-notifications tiles don't exist on trades (skipped per agent note). (12) Concierge FAB regression: concierge-fab visible on /risk, /workers, /licences, /notifications, /reports (count=1 each) and HIDDEN on /incident (count=0) — carries over the iter_5 HIDE_ON_PREFIXES fix. MINOR FINDINGS noted in frontend_issues. Deprecated-library warnings carry over from prior iterations (props.pointerEvents from react-navigation, [expo-notifications] push-token notice).

minor.issue: Demo licence rows reference worker_id values that aren't present in the trades demo /api/workers list, so the licences list shows '—' instead of the worker name on every row. Mobile UI correctly falls back; this is a SafeBase backend seed-data mismatch (not a mobile bug). Worth flagging to the SafeBase team.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec said 'INHERENT EXTREME / RESIDUAL LOW pills' but the LevelPill is only rendered for inherent_level. Residual is shown as plain text 'Residual: 4' in the bottom row. Consider adding a second LevelPill so both inherent and residual are visually equivalent.

issues: Worker name placeholder '—' shows when worker_id is missing from /api/workers. Mobile already falls back gracefully; consider a more descriptive label like 'Worker not on register'.

react_native_issues.issue: Warning emitted on every navigation: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Originates from inside react-navigation; not actionable in this repo. Reference: shows up in dev console on every screen transition.
Warning: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' Expected on web preview; push-token registration path can only be exercised on a native build.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/frontend/app/risk/index.tsx render a second LevelPill for residual_level alongside the inherent pill so both inherent + residual show as coloured pills (matches the iteration spec wording 'INHERENT EXTREME / RESIDUAL LOW pills').

OPTIONAL: Mention to the SafeBase backend team that the trades demo /api/licences worker_id values don't match /api/workers, so the mobile list shows '—' for every worker name. Mobile is already safe-fallback; this is purely a seed-data cleanup on the backend.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/modules.tsx:88 routeFor() correctly maps every dedicated mobile screen — incidents/risks/workers/licences/workflows/notifications/compliance-inbox/inbox/reports/settings-* — so future module tile additions won't accidentally land back on /module/[slug]. Clean.

/app/frontend/src/components/RiskMatrix.tsx:18 riskLevel() thresholds now exactly mirror backend _compute_risk_level (≤4 low, ≤9 medium, ≤15 high, else extreme). Verified visually with cell-4-4 (16/extreme) and cell-2-2 (4/low).

/app/frontend/app/risk/new.tsx:62 submit() sends the exact backend field names (likelihood/consequence/residual_likelihood/residual_consequence + hrcw_flags array + review_frequency single value). No client-side scoring — backend auto-computes inherent_score/level + residual_score/level, which then surface on the /risk row.
/app/frontend/app/licences/index.tsx falls back to '—' when workers[l.worker_id] is undefined; safe but could be more descriptive (see design_issues).

success_rate.backend: NA (frontend-only iteration). All SafeBase backend endpoints we exercised through the UI succeeded: GET /api/workers (4 demo rows), POST /api/workers (TEST Worker Z9 added + visible after reload), GET /api/licences (6 demo rows), POST /api/licences (TEST-001 + 2027-12-31 created), POST /api/licences/{id}/remind (Reminder queued Alert), GET /api/notifications (4 unread rows), GET /api/reports (10 reports), GET /api/reports/compliance_score (rendered without crash), GET /api/workflows/catalog (5 types), GET /api/workflows/summary (KPIs populated), POST /api/workflows/new_employee (instance created, stepper rendered), GET /api/safety/risks (empty list → list w/ TEST RISK after submit), POST /api/safety/risks (TEST RISK persisted, inherent_score 16 / extreme returned). Two harmless 401 console errors observed on first load — likely a token-warm-up call that doesn't affect the user flow.
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 12 review points PASS. /workers list+filter+create, /licences list+filter+remind+create, /risk empty-state→/risk/new full-field render+5x5 matrix+submit→register row, /notifications list w/ mark-all, /reports 10-item catalog + generic /reports/[type] render, /workflows 5-type catalog + KPI + wf-new instance creation, modules-tab native-route regression, concierge-FAB visible on Phase 1B screens + hidden on /incident.

seed_data_creation: Created via UI for verification (safe to leave): one worker 'TEST Worker Z9' (trades.demo), one licence 'TEST-001' WHITE_CARD expiry 2027-12-31, one risk 'TEST RISK' inherent 4×4=16 extreme / residual 2×2=4 low, one workflow instance of new_employee. All visible in their respective registers after the test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1B cross-industry spine is fully verified. Useful selectors for future iterations: /workers uses workers-back, add-worker-btn, workers-search, worker-row-{id}, worker-delete-{id}; new worker uses worker-name/email/phone/trade + role-{value} chips + worker-submit. /licences uses lic-back, add-licence-btn, lic-search, lic-filter-{all|active|expiring_soon|expired}, licence-row-{id}, lic-remind-{id}, lic-delete-{id}; new licence uses worker-{worker_id} + type-{value} + lic-number/authority/issue/expiry + lic-submit. /risk uses risk-back, add-risk-btn, risk-search, risk-filter-{all|low|medium|high|extreme}, risk-row-{id}; new risk uses risk-title/category/activity/process/hazard/consequence/existing-controls/proposed-controls/owner/due + matrix-inherent-cell-{l}-{c} and matrix-residual-cell-{l}-{c} (readouts at matrix-inherent-readout / matrix-residual-readout) + freq-{value} (single-select) + hrcw-{value} (multi-select, 10 options) + risk-submit. /notifications uses notif-back, notif-mark-all, notif-row-{index}. /reports uses reports-back + report-{type} for the 10 types: compliance_score, incidents_trend, licence_expiry, training_matrix, swms_register, toolbox_talks_log, risk_register_export, inspections_summary, plant_register, worker_roster. /workflows uses workflows-back, wf-type-{type} (new_employee, incident_resolution, swms_job_start, annual_review, subcontractor), wf-new. Modules tab does NOT have module-licences/workflows/notifications tiles on trades industry (only compliance-inbox) — skip silently if testing those. Concierge FAB still gated by HIDE_ON_PREFIXES in /app/frontend/src/components/FloatingOverlays.tsx (hidden on /incident, /capture, /chat).
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. Two minor cosmetic items: (a) /risk row missing the residual LevelPill (only inherent pill shows — see action_items) and (b) trades demo licence seed data references worker_ids not in the workers list (worker name shows '—' in /licences rows — see backend_issues.minor and design_issues). Neither prevents the workflow from completing.
